note: Stage 3, seventh level: line up the vertical sum (two-digit plus two-digit, no carrying). Four teaching scenes — blocks of twenty-three and fifteen, adding the ones, adding the tens, then the vertical sum with digits flying into their columns. Answer phase: listen and tap the sum / drag six digits into the six slots / find the vertical sum that is wrong.

lines.text: Twenty-three plus fifteen. Let's add them up.
We add the ones. Three plus five equals eight.
We add the tens. Two plus one equals three.
Line up the ones and tens. Twenty-three plus fifteen equals thirty-eight.
Drag the numbers to line up the ones and tens.
